programmes.d: Catchpole showcases the Rolls-Royce Wraith's elegance and power! Then, witness the wild, amphibious Scamander!
Meaden attempts a world record! Then, witness the M5 on a frozen lake and a drive in the LFA!

EVO editors test nine contenders and break down their choices on the road to crowning Car of the Year 2023!
Explore the Mercedes-AMG G 63's wild power! Then, Henry Catchpole drives the Aston N430 in Scotland!
Ride with Richard Meaden in a rare 1969 Porsche 911 S rally car. Then, see Chris Harris in a GT3 RS!
Explore Geneva's standouts, from Civic Concept to Model X, as well as the bold cars and concepts in Paris!
Join a 1,000-mile Lamborghini Espada adventure, mixing vintage charm, stunning roads and pure Lambo spirit!
Checks out the new Porsche Cayman GT4, which is powered by a 3.8-L engine with 385 hp.
Explore Japan's icons as evo tests the Impreza 22B, LFA and GT-R Nismo in a celebration of pure performance!
Go on a 1000-mile Mille Miglia rally with stunning Ferraris, wild traffic jams and unforgettable scenery!
Experience Goodwood Festival of Speed as legendary cars and drivers tear up the hill in nonstop celebration!
Follow the Aston Martin Valkyrie from Silverstone to Le Mans in a road trip showcasing power and design!
Join a thrilling Mille Miglia journey in a Bugatti Veyron Vitesse over 1,000 exhilarating miles!
Explore the groundbreaking RS2 and B5 RS4. Then, Audi Sport transforms rally prowess into road legends!
Dive into Audi Sport's journey in rallying, Quattro revolution and its iconic performance cars.
Race in the F56 Mini Challenge at Brands Hatch. Then, compare the BMW M4 with the M5.
Vegas Golden Knights goalie Marc-Andre Fleury comes to Count's Kustoms looking for an All-American muscle car fit for a three-time Stanley Cup champion.
Brann Dailor, drummer for the Grammy-winning heavy metal band Mastodon, brings in his 1970 Cadillac Coupe DeVille for some much needed Counts Kustoms love.

Danny is commissioned to custom paint a brand new pick-up for a charity auction for the local YMCA. But Danny can't stop at paint, he adds the ultimate accessory a matching chopper that fits in the back.

When the World Series of Poker guys want a Count's Kustoms chopper as the ultimate online giveaway, Danny is determined to make it something special. Meanwhile, Mike and Ryan check go for a spin in a 1957 Bel Air.

Lonnie, one of the shop's long time painters, wants to give his Lincoln lowrider a new, but simple, paint job. Meanwhile, Mike and Paul find a Rolls Royce that used to belong to Donny and Marie Osmond.
When a client rolls into Count's Kustoms with a beautiful 1955 Chevy Nomad, Danny can't help but want the car for his collection.
Ryan and Kevin head to the Bonneville Salt Flats to see The Turbinator, a vehicle that holds a land speed record try to break 500 MPH.

After the vehicle that holds a land speed record is seriously damaged and repaired, the guys give it a sleek look. Then, the crew heads to Bonneville, UT to watch the Turbinator go for the record again.

The local Fox News channel wants to update their Ford Expedition Storm Chaser in a mobile news unit with an elaborate paint scheme that they can also bring to schools to help kids learn about weather.
Danny and Shannon are in motorcycle heaven when they are asked to restore a rare 1957 Harley Davidson Pan head prototype that has spent the last 20 years in their client's living room.

Ryan and Kevin find a 1972 Datsun 240z that Danny agrees to flip. But when he has a last-minute change of heart, Ryan must figure out how to make Danny's vision a reality without derailing the project.
Kevin's brother Steve wants a 1980 Kawasaki KZ100 motorcycle tricked out just like the ones on the classic TV series, CHiPs.

A 1977 Corvette Stingray arrives with seven layers of paint and too many problems to count. The restoration makes no sense, but Dan takes it. A 1965 Cobra is brought in for a simple wiring job. Then, the owner decides to wrap the car like a fighter jet.

A 1983 Avanti shows up with $58,000 worth of mismatched parts and an escalating cascade of hidden problems. A 3100 Chevy Pick-up rolls in with rope holding the doors shut, but the team soon learns that this is the tip of a very ugly iceberg.

Dan and the team take on the restorations of a 1965 Cadillac Deville and a 1984 Monte Carlo. The 'caddie' is so full of leaves and rat droppings that it's a health hazard. The Monte Carlo is intended as an anniversary present.

Dan and the team take on the restorations of a 1964 Chevrolet impala and a 1957 Bel Air wagon. When the impala arrives, it is one step away from the junkyard. Due to a mistake in the shop, the restoration of the Bel Air goes further than intended.

Dan's team take on the restorations of a 1966 Volkswagen Beetle and a 1976 TR6 convertible. The TR6 looks bad, but Dan sees hidden potential for it to become a rare 'survivor' car that still has its original paint and fixtures.

Dan and the team take on the restorations of a 1965 Mustang fastback and a 1951 Studebaker truck. The mustang is for a friend whose plans are far bigger than his budget, and the Studebaker needs a unique design to make it a world-class show vehicle.

In honor of wounded veterans, Dan and the team attempt a near-impossible conversion by making a 1970 Chevelle SS handicapped accessible. The shop's first pre-war restoration of a 1926 Velie with no manuals or parts takes them into uncharted territory.

Dan and the team take on the restorations of a 1963 corvette and a 1931 Model A hot rod. The corvette has to be ready in time for a wedding in less than two months. The hot rod has been torn to pieces by a well-intentioned internet mechanic.

Watch the showdown between the Porsche GT3 RS, McLaren 750S and Radical SR3 XXR.
evo's Editorial Director, Harry Metcalfe, drives the 2012 Mille Miglia in a 1955 Alfa 1900 SS across Italy.
Join the Mk2 Escort at the Woodpecker Rally then a track battle between the McLaren P1 and Porsche 918 Spyder.
